svg.text: Set B Exercise3 - SOURCE ERROR DIAGRAM
1. Nine centres are drawn; 6X does not specify the full set.
Use 9X Ø.19 THRU EQSP if all nine holes are identical.
Cross out the two extra Ø.19 leaders as duplicate notes.
2. Nine equal centres spanning 4.00 imply pitch .50.
State 8 SPACES @ .50 = 4.00 for the chosen pattern.
3. 4.50 follows 4.00 + 2 x R.25; mark it REFERENCE.
Use 2X R.25 if both ends have that intended radius.
Original 6X, EQSP and .09 source labels retained.
Nine identical holes are an explicit chosen correction.
Both ends R.25 is a stated interpretation.
Native paper markup; no manufacturing CAD claimed.
